decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template was announced on the website as a new recommendation and fits the firm's core web and shop business, so management will stand by it and treat any weak early sales as a matter of ramp-up time.
A responsive website template costs little to maintain and sits squarely within the firm's announced direction, so the earlier investment and commitment favour keeping it.
Premium support is tied to existing customer relationships, and withdrawing a visible service promise would undercut the earlier decision and the firm's reputation.
The version management tool required substantial development effort and was given its own page, so sunk costs and public commitment strongly favour persisting with it.

The data processing contract tool has its own page and responded to GDPR demand, so management would attribute any post-2018 demand slump to temporary effects and keep it despite some risk of fading interest.
